description: Minimal and fast autopairs plugin. Automatically inserts matching closing brackets, quotes, and other paired characters as you type, with smart neighborhood-based conditions.
author: nvim-mini
tagline: Minimal autopairs: smart bracket and quote completion as you type

options.label: Enable in Insert Mode
options.description: Create pair mappings in Insert mode. This is the primary mode for autopairs and is enabled by default.

options.label: Enable in Command Mode
options.description: Create pair mappings in Command-line mode (:). Disabled by default — can interfere with complex Ex commands.

options.label: Enable in Terminal Mode
options.description: Create pair mappings in Terminal mode. Disabled by default — can conflict with interactive terminal programs like ipython or radian that have their own autopair behavior.

options.label: Pair Mappings
options.description: Table defining which characters trigger autopair behavior and how. Each key is the typed character. Each value is a table with: 'action' ("open", "close", or "closeopen"), 'pair' (two-char string), 'neigh_pattern' (Lua pattern matched against the two chars surrounding the cursor — \r = line start, \n = line end), and optional 'register' ({bs=true, cr=true} controlling <BS>/<CR> pair recognition). Set a key's value to false to disable that mapping entirely.
options.default:
{
  ['('] = { action = 'open',      pair = '()',  neigh_pattern = '^[^\\]' },
  ['['] = { action = 'open',      pair = '[]',  neigh_pattern = '^[^\\]' },
  ['{'] = { action = 'open',      pair = '{}',  neigh_pattern = '^[^\\]' },

  [')'] = { action = 'close',     pair = '()',  neigh_pattern = '^[^\\]' },
  [']'] = { action = 'close',     pair = '[]',  neigh_pattern = '^[^\\]' },
  ['}'] = { action = 'close',     pair = '{}',  neigh_pattern = '^[^\\]' },

  -- Quotes: not recognized by <CR> (register.cr = false)
  -- '\'' only inserts pair when not preceded by a letter (avoids contractions)
  ['"'] = { action = 'closeopen', pair = '""', neigh_pattern = '^[^\\]',   register = { cr = false } },
  ["'"] = { action = 'closeopen', pair = "''", neigh_pattern = '^[^%a\\]', register = { cr = false } },
  ['`'] = { action = 'closeopen', pair = '``',  neigh_pattern = '^[^\\]',   register = { cr = false } },
}

functions.name: map
functions.label: Add Global Pair Mapping
functions.description: Register a global autopair mapping for a character in the given mode
functions.whatItDoes: Adds an autopair mapping globally (all buffers). Equivalent to calling MiniPairs.map(). Use this to add pairs like <> or $$ that aren't in the default config. Optionally supply a neigh_pattern (Lua pattern for cursor neighborhood) to control when the pair fires, and register_bs/register_cr to opt out of <BS>/<CR> recognition.

params.name: mode
params.description: Vim mode: 'i' (insert), 'c' (command), 't' (terminal)

params.name: lhs
params.description: The character to map (e.g., '<', '$')

params.name: action
params.description: Pair action: 'open', 'close', or 'closeopen'

params.name: pair
params.description: Two-character pair string (e.g., '<>', '$$')

params.name: neigh_pattern
params.description: Lua pattern matched against the two-character neighborhood around the cursor. \r = line start, \n = line end. E.g., '^[^%a]' = don't fire after a letter. Omit to use the plugin default (always fire).

params.name: register_bs
params.description: Whether <BS> should recognise this pair and delete both characters. Defaults to true.

params.name: register_cr
params.description: Whether <CR> inside this pair should add an indented newline with closing char below. Defaults to true.

functions.luaCall: require('mini.pairs').map($params.mode, $params.lhs, { action = $params.action, pair = $params.pair, neigh_pattern = $params.neigh_pattern, register = { bs = $params.register_bs, cr = $params.register_cr } })

functions.name: map_buf
functions.label: Add Buffer-Local Pair Mapping
functions.description: Register an autopair mapping for a character in the current buffer only
functions.whatItDoes: Adds an autopair mapping scoped to a single buffer. Useful in FileType autocmds to add language-specific pairs (e.g., $$ for LaTeX, | for Ruby blocks). Optionally supply neigh_pattern and register flags to fine-tune behavior.

params.name: mode
params.description: Vim mode: 'i' (insert), 'c' (command), 't' (terminal)

params.name: lhs
params.description: The character to map (e.g., '$', '|')

params.name: action
params.description: Pair action: 'open', 'close', or 'closeopen'

params.name: pair
params.description: Two-character pair string (e.g., '$$', '||')

params.name: neigh_pattern
params.description: Lua pattern matched against the two-character neighborhood around the cursor. Omit to use the plugin default (always fire).

params.name: register_bs
params.description: Whether <BS> should recognise this pair and delete both characters. Defaults to true.

params.name: register_cr
params.description: Whether <CR> inside this pair adds an indented newline. Defaults to true.

functions.luaCall: require('mini.pairs').map_buf(0, $params.mode, $params.lhs, { action = $params.action, pair = $params.pair, neigh_pattern = $params.neigh_pattern, register = { bs = $params.register_bs, cr = $params.register_cr } })

functions.name: unmap
functions.label: Remove Global Pair Mapping
functions.description: Remove a previously registered global autopair mapping
functions.whatItDoes: Unregisters a global pair mapping added with MiniPairs.map(). Supply the exact pair string to ensure the pair is deregistered from <BS> and <CR> handlers.

params.name: mode
params.description: Vim mode the mapping is in: 'i', 'c', or 't'

params.name: lhs
params.description: The character whose mapping to remove

params.name: pair
params.description: The pair string to deregister (e.g., '()'). Supply '' to skip deregistration.

functions.name: unmap_buf
functions.label: Remove Buffer-Local Pair Mapping
functions.description: Remove a buffer-local autopair mapping from the current buffer
functions.whatItDoes: Unregisters a buffer-local pair mapping added with MiniPairs.map_buf(). Only reverts map_buf() mappings — use inoremap <buffer> to revert global mappings on a per-buffer basis.

params.name: mode
params.description: Vim mode the mapping is in: 'i', 'c', or 't'

params.name: lhs
params.description: The character whose mapping to remove

params.name: pair
params.description: The pair string to deregister. Supply '' to skip deregistration.

functionTemplates.label: Add <> Angle Bracket Pair
functionTemplates.shortDescription: Register < as an open pair mapping for angle brackets, guarded against comparisons
functionTemplates.whatItDoes: Adds < > as an autopair in Insert mode. The neigh_pattern '^[^%a<>]' prevents firing when < is preceded by a letter or another angle bracket, avoiding interference with comparison operators and generics.

functionTemplates.label: Add $$ LaTeX Pair (Buffer-Local)
functionTemplates.shortDescription: Register $ as a closeopen pair for LaTeX math in the current buffer
functionTemplates.whatItDoes: Adds $$ as a buffer-local autopair for LaTeX math mode. register_cr is false because <CR> inside $$ should not insert an indented newline — math mode is typically inline. Typically used inside a FileType autocmd for tex files.
